title: SMSociety 2026 Conference Programme
snippet: Fabio Giglietto was a featured panelist at the 2026 International Conference on Social Media & Society (#SMSociety) in Glasgow, UK. He spoke on the panel titled 'Meta Content Library Community Roundtable – Where to for Social Media Research?' to discuss platform transparency and future data access for academic researchers.
description: An announcement for the International Conference on Social Media & Society listing Professor Fabio Giglietto as an expert panelist discussing future pathways for social media research following the closure of CrowdTangle.

title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: An Italian news article reporting on the findings of Fabio Giglietto's research at the University of Urbino. The study, which analyzed over 2.5 million Facebook posts, showed how Meta's recommendation algorithms restricted the visibility of mainstream politicians. The article highlights how these findings sparked formal inquiries within the European Parliament.
description: An Italian news article discussing a study led by Fabio Giglietto at the University of Urbino (UniUrb) regarding how Meta's recommendation algorithms restricted the visibility of mainstream politicians, which subsequently sparked formal inquiries in the European Parliament.
